description: Summe Einspeisung Hochspannung is a series of datasets listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Berlin Open Data. Die Summe aller Einspeisungen ist die Summe der Einspeisungen von dezentralen Erzeugungsanlagen in das Hochspannungsnetz. Diese werden entweder gemessen (zum Beispiel bei EEG über 500 kW) oder über Einspeiseprofile (zum Beispiel Kleinkraftwerke, EEG unter 500 kW) ermittelt. Die Summe der Einspeisungen in das Hochspannungsnetz im zeitlichen Verlauf ist hier veröffentlicht. Coverage: Berlin Open Data. The portal lists 6 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Berlin Open Data. Its tags are dezentrale_erzeugungsanlagen, einspeisung, netzeinspeisung, stromnzv_par._17, veröffentlichungspflichten_nach_stromnzv. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-01-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
